# Etsy

4 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 4 advanced (5) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

Etsy listing data: a listing by id or URL, a shop's whole catalog, similar-listing recommendations, and search suggestions. Canonical Product schema.

## GET /v1/etsy/product - 5 credits (advanced)

Get an Etsy listing by id or URL

**Cost** 5 credits (advanced) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Product · **Pagination** none

Returns one Etsy listing: title, description, price, currency, images, shop name, in-stock flag, and quantity. Pass the numeric listing id or the full etsy.com/listing/{id} URL. Search is not available on this surface yet; start from a known listing id or from GET /v1/etsy/shop/products. Similar listings for the same product: GET /v1/etsy/product/similar.

**Query params**

- `product_id` (optional, string) - Etsy listing id, the numeric id in a listing URL: etsy.com/listing/1215970085 is listing id 1215970085. Listing ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/etsy/shop/products and GET /v1/etsy/product/similar. · e.g. `1215970085`
- `url` (optional, string) - Full Etsy listing URL, for example https://www.etsy.com/listing/1215970085/custom-air-freshener. The listing id is extracted from the path.
- `country` (optional, string) - Ship-to country as a two-letter code. Default US. Changes currency and copy language when the listing supports it.
- `currency` (optional, string) - ISO 4217 currency code for the displayed price. Default USD.
- `language` (optional, string) - Listing copy locale, for example en-US, en-GB, fr, de. Default en-US.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `product_id`, `url`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/etsy/product?product_id=1215970085" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/etsy/product/similar - 5 credits (advanced)

Get listings similar to an Etsy product

**Cost** 5 credits (advanced) · **Cache** 120s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** ProductList · **Pagination** single page - Upstream similar/v2 has no page or cursor param; it returns one fixed window of similar listings.

Returns listings Etsy considers similar to a given product, typically around 12 rows, each with listing id, title, price, sale price where discounted, image, shop name, and the shop's aggregate rating. Pass the listing id or the listing URL. This is a single page: there is no cursor.

**Query params**

- `product_id` (optional, string) - Etsy listing id, the numeric id in a listing URL: etsy.com/listing/1215970085 is listing id 1215970085. Listing ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/etsy/shop/products and GET /v1/etsy/product/similar. · e.g. `1215970085`
- `url` (optional, string) - Full Etsy listing URL, for example https://www.etsy.com/listing/1215970085/custom-air-freshener. The listing id is extracted from the path.
- `country` (optional, string) - Ship-to country as a two-letter code. Default US. Changes currency and copy language when the listing supports it.
- `currency` (optional, string) - ISO 4217 currency code for displayed prices. Default USD.
- `language` (optional, string) - Listing copy locale. Default en-US.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `product_id`, `url`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/etsy/product/similar?product_id=1215970085" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/etsy/search/suggestions - 5 credits (advanced)

Get Etsy search suggestions

**Cost** 5 credits (advanced) · **Cache** 120s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** SearchResult · **Pagination** single page - Fixed-window autocomplete: upstream returns a single non-cursored suggestion list.

Returns Etsy's search autocomplete suggestions for a partial query, the same terms the search box shows. Useful for keyword expansion. Full listing search is not available on this surface yet.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Partial search query to autocomplete, for example leather. · e.g. `leather`

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/etsy/search/suggestions?query=leather" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/etsy/shop/products - 5 credits (advanced)

List products in an Etsy shop

**Cost** 5 credits (advanced) · **Cache** 120s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** ProductList · **Pagination** page - `page`, page size `limit`

Returns one page of listings from an Etsy shop, 36 per page, each with listing id, title, price, original price where discounted, image, shop name, and listing URL. Pass the shop name (AceElegance) or the shop URL. Sort by most_recent (default), price_low, or price_high. The result total Etsy reports equals the page size, so it is not returned: paginate until a page comes back short. Feed a returned listing id into GET /v1/etsy/product for the full listing.

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - Etsy shop name, the path in etsy.com/shop/AceElegance. Shop names also come back on every product as product.seller. · e.g. `AceElegance`
- `url` (optional, string) - Full Etsy shop URL, for example https://www.etsy.com/shop/AceElegance or https://aceelegance.etsy.com.
- `page` (optional, integer, min 1) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-36) - Listings per page, 1 to 36. Default 36.
- `sort_by` (optional, enum: most_recent | price_low | price_high) - Result ordering: most_recent (default), price_low, or price_high.
- `currency` (optional, string) - ISO 4217 currency code for displayed prices. Default USD.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/etsy/shop/products?id=AceElegance" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
